# Independent review: pair-zero-compatible geometry

Verdict: ACCEPT_PAIRZERO_GEOMETRY_DICTIONARY_AND_CONTROLS_ONLY.
Final candidate: PAIRZERO_GEOMETRY.md, SHA256
`ed0fb279a1949bbc0c39bff88fe0c48ebe95b5463f0798cff79dbcd91042ec6f`.
Initial mathematical candidate: SHA256
`d99cb0b01dc331149ab9e025dc90cbe32a09894f5677eebe4bedac1632bb5c91`.
Reviewer: /root/pairzero_geometry_review. Date: 2026-09-16.
Revision disposition: CLEAN_SCOPE_ONLY_REVISION.

The complete initial and final candidates were read. P1--P13 have not
changed mathematically. No correction is required to the bounded claims.
This is exact dictionary/control acceptance, not sign progress for theta V,
canonical admission, Lean certification, or any proof/refutation of RH.

## Direct evidence

The 920221-byte Loi--Zedda arXiv:1712.04298v1 PDF was independently hashed:
`5e25d237b432f342f0402cae5c75a3b7c80baf3d15fb0818c3ae144f6d460215`.
The supplied extract has hash
`73738f1dac67138bc3565b976374b8698cb7ad0c9e1b9661524c287a6cad9cdd`.
Relevant text was independently regenerated from PDF pages 30--31:
Definition 2.2.2 and Theorem 2.2.4 are on printed page 24 and the proof
continues on printed page 25. These locators are correct. Printed pages
6--8 were also read directly for normalization and N<=infinity.

The following source inputs were fully read and their exact hashes checked:

- LOGVCURV_INTAKE: `074a6ee11edf58ed502f8a41454515c06b5d286605b53ff0fe9e889981a3b929`.
- LOGVCURV_PREFLIGHT: `79755565b206eb578a3681b5ef68a0580776869c61703a62a63625b6fcb182a9`.
- SUPPORTSTABILITY_INTAKE: `14f8e48fd325f41df7b46f1da84140e1ff56b16df95ee3c6b9c0000f9ae9e895`.

Previously accepted theta holomorphy, P2, log-curvature obstruction and
C(0,0)>0 are inputs here. This does not reprove all their earlier source
estimates. The inherited f0 four-shift control is historical context; the
new independently checked controls are P10--P13.

No search, dispatch, repository mutation, or descendant was used. Canonical
read-only plan remained HOLD with ACTIVE control and writes_performed=false.
The only output written by this reviewer is this assigned staging review.

## Moving boundary and polarization: P3--P5

The substitution s=u^2-a^2 has ds=2u du and sends [|a|,infinity) to
[0,infinity), proving P3 with the boundary intact. For s>0, u>0 and

    partial_a H=(a/u) f'(u+ib), partial_b H=i f'(u+ib),
    partial_s H=f'(u+ib)/(2u).

Using the two Wirtinger operators gives exactly
partial_bar_z H=(a-u)partial_s H and
partial_z H=(a+u)partial_s H, including both signs. Thus the direct field
is generally nonholomorphic. No bounded generator or conclusion at
s=a=0 follows from this pointwise calculation; the candidate does not
claim one.

A holomorphic Hilbert feature with diagonal norm D gives a
sesquiholomorphic kernel. Equality of its diagonal with V(conj(z),z)
forces equality of all mixed Taylor coefficients and hence P5 locally.
Individual positive norms from P3 do not supply the required cross inner
products or holomorphic feature.

## Calabi mapping and normalization: P6--P8

For phi=log D, the anchored diastasis is
phi(z)+phi(0)-phi(z,0)-phi(0,z), exactly H(conj(z),z).
Nonzero factors and a logarithm exist near (0,0), where d>0. The metric
coefficient at 0 is the paid C(0,0)>0; continuity yields a local Kahler
metric without a global scalar-metric hypothesis.

The definition's quote, with typographical normalization, is exact:
"if the matrix (sjk) is semipositive definite of rank N."
Source (1.5), (2.2) and Theorem 2.2.4 give b=1, Fubini--Study curvature
4, and potential log(1+sum |h_j|^2). Printed pages 6--8 explicitly allow
N<=infinity. No missing b or 1/b factor affects the candidate.

Subtracting 1 from R gives P7. Under the proposed Q factorization,

    <Psi(z),Psi(w)>
    = V(conj(z),0)V(0,w)/d * [1+Q(conj(z),w)]
    = V(conj(z),w),

so P8 is correctly normalized. Conversely orthogonal projection off the
feature at 0 gives S0; multiplication by sqrt(d)/V(0,z) gives Q.
This preserves every finite local family and arbitrary complex coefficients.
All finite Taylor coefficient matrices must be PSD. Analyticity and that
all-order condition give convergent local Hilbert features; a finite
low-order check does not suffice.

The flat criterion uses H itself. Differentiating a PSD kernel by finite
differences makes its mixed derivative PSD, which here would contradict
the accepted C obstruction. The projective condition exp(H)-1 is distinct
and allows pair zeros. The example 1+zw verifies that distinction.

## Conditional continuation in the same Hilbert space: P9

P9 is valid. Within a feature domain, its derivative norms equal the
mixed Taylor coefficients of the full kernel. A compact tube around the
paired diagonal (conj(p),p) along a compact path in S lies in S x S.
Scalar Cauchy estimates yield common M,rho there and therefore

    ||Psi^(n)(p)/n!|| <= sqrt(M) rho^(-n).

The vector Taylor series extends the SAME Hilbert-valued feature to a
disk of radius rho, potentially beyond its current domain. On overlap
it agrees with the old feature, and its kernel identity extends by
analytic uniqueness. Repeating along the compact path uses no fresh
PSD assumption at new points. Unique continuation and monodromy on the
simply connected strip give a single global feature and its full product
kernel identity.

PSD on a real interval yields initial local coefficient PSD by finite
differences. A local Calabi feature at 0 conversely continues to I. This
is an exact ordinary-PSD dictionary with no fractional root. Initial
all-order coefficient positivity is still unpaid.

## Polynomial metric and finite negative row: P10--P12

For r>=0, 1+r^4>=2r^2 and P(0)=1 imply P(r)>0. Direct radial
differentiation gives

    partial_z partial_bar_z log P
      = [P P' + r P P'' - r(P')^2]/P^2.

Independent expansion gives numerator coefficients
(1,-1,35/4,20,35/4,-1,1). The displayed decomposition is exact, with
1-r+r^2>0, so the scalar metric is strictly positive everywhere.
Yet K(z,0)=1 and the anchored degree-two coefficient is -1/4; the
required coefficient matrix is not PSD.

The finite row moments are exactly (0,0,2,-12h,50h^2). At h=1/100 its
quadratic form is -1+144h^2+2500h^4=-39423/40000. The three nodes lie in
I. These rational identities were independently checked with Fraction
arithmetic after the algebraic derivation. This is no numerical theta
scan. It refutes the general transfer from positive diagonal and scalar
metric to Gram positivity, not the theta V target.

## Multiplier cancellation: P13

Exact multiplication yields (1,2,3/4,3/4,2,1), all positive. The multiplier
and product thus have explicit monomial Gram features, while K has the
negative row just checked. General multiplier cancellation is false.
The candidate properly invokes no unverified Quillen/Catlin theorem.
A nonvanishing scalar congruence is invertible diagonal congruence on each
finite real family and preserves inertia; it cannot fix a negative row.

## Scope-only revision and remaining status

The revised SUPPORTSTABILITY provenance is supported by its sections 4
and 6, read directly: W2 was already reduced to p in unweighted L2, and
the user explicitly returned before another critical-tail expansion.
The revision correctly treats W2 as an inherited diagnostic and forbids
redispatching that old equivalent target as new work. The holomorphic
capitalization correction is immaterial. P1--P13 remain unchanged.

Accept the dictionary, CR defect, conditional continuation and explicit
negative controls only. Neither Calabi's criterion nor this audit gives
a theta coefficient factorization or a new lower bound for original V.
No new full-source hypothesis or proof request is selected by this review.

Final verdict: ACCEPT_PAIRZERO_GEOMETRY_DICTIONARY_AND_CONTROLS_ONLY.
Revision disposition: CLEAN_SCOPE_ONLY_REVISION.
